site_name: Geoffrey Close Estate, Off Flaxman Road, Camberwell
description: Application for a non-material amendment following a grant of planning permission ref. 20/03257/FUL (Demolition of all existing buildings and the comprehensive redevelopment of the Geoffrey Close Estate comprising the erection of 6 residential buildings ranging from 5 to 13 storeys providing 441 residential dwellings including affordable housing (Use Class C3), associated community facilities, including; a residents community centre and residents only gym, landscaping and public realm works, including private and communal amenity space, car and cycle parking including visitors cycle parking, and associated infrastructure works.), granted on 20.12.2021.Amendment sought:Amendments to Blocks B1 and B2 relating principally to the arrangement of stair and lift cores, smoke ventilation strategies, and associated internal layouts.
